http-xhr-backend.description: Adds 'withXhr' to 'provideHttpClient' function calls when the 'HttpXhrBackend' is used. For more information see: https://angular.dev/api/common/http/withXhr

provide-incremental-hydration.description: Updates 'provideClientHydration' calls: adds 'withNoIncrementalHydration' to preserve pre-v22 behavior and removes redundant 'withIncrementalHydration' since incremental hydration is now enabled by default.
